pages.text: Dinner was ready. Time for the whole family to sit round the long table.
Lulu ran over. "Today I will sit beside Mom."
Aunt Rosa clapped. "I will choose the seats! You there, you here!"
She sat cousins here and there. A seated cousin stood up again.
"No, again! Tallest to shortest would be better!" Everyone changed seats.
Lulu went from one end to the other, farther and farther from Mom's seat.
Soup steamed on the table. "Children, it will get cold!" Mom said with a smile.
Lulu held the empty chair beside Mom with both hands. "This is my seat!"
Mom came and sat beside Lulu. The cousins each settled into a nearby seat.
"Thank you for the meal!" Everyone was ready. Aunt Rosa found her own seat at the far end. She waved from a long way off.
